stem: A propagation protocol works well for one cultivar but performs poorly for another under otherwise similar conditions. What is the best next interpretation?
choices: Propagation response can be genotype-dependent, so cultivar-specific optimization and sanitation/environment checks are appropriate
The protocol must work identically for every genotype
The only valid response is to increase fertilizer strength
rationale: Cannabis propagation responses can vary among genotypes, and success also depends on material condition, sanitation, rooting environment and acclimatization.
